correctness.rationale: Complete proof: constant completion count (n-1)! proves uniform marked-cycle size; conjugation by (i i+1), i>=2, preserves the length and reverses the adjacent comparison except the two exact-image configurations, whose conditional probabilities coincide. Conditioning on successor of 1 and the complement yields the exact q(n,k) four-case law; summing gives covariance (n²−3n+4)/(4n(n−1)). The included standard-library exact-rational program exhaustively verifies all cases n=3,...,9 with 336 assertions, independently reconstructing marked cycle length. Finite verification is supplementary to unrestricted proof.

originality.rationale: Compared the actual implication of unmarked cycle-type/descent formulas in Fulman, Gessel–Zhuang and Reutenauer, plus published position-resolved fixed-point/descent and total-cycle/inversion results, with the marked orbit length conditional law. value.rationale: A single fine global marked-orbit statistic exerts all its linear influence on one local descent coordinate while every later coordinate remains conditionally fair across every orbit length. The boundary is exact, the first-site law splits into four natural regimes and yields positive covariance tending 1/4. This supplies a structural probabilistic feature not captured by marginal Eulerian enumerations or aggregate cycle counts, useful in local/global permutation dependence comparisons.
